verify.note: verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1, Undead, 180 s with durationVariation 20, on the merged bundled-round tree. Published 969.0 (PR #2); delta -0.05.

summary: Fire Destruction with Incinerate as the filler, Conflagrate, Fire and Brimstone, Shadow and Flame and Aftermath, plus Malediction and Pandemic, Succubus out and Firestone. Shipped as its own playstyle on Undead, 1.7% behind Shadow Bolt Destruction.
rotation: Life Tap below 5% mana or when Incinerate costs more than the mana left
Bane of Doom when it lands before the fight ends (more than 60 s left)
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when down or under 2 s left (more than 9 s left)
Immolate when down or under 2 s left (more than 6 s left)
Conflagrate on cooldown while Immolate is up
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 38 spell power and 13 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Demon sensitivity: no owner scaling 937.3, Succubus melee halved 937.4, both 913.2; without owner scaling the Succubus-sacrifice build (950.8) would be the pick (first set)
Firestone is 24 ahead of Spellstone; Felhunter out 25 behind, Imp 35
Undead and Gnome tie (969.0 / 968.9 at 180 s) and Undead is 1.3 ahead at 300 s, so the preset moved to Undead
Whether Incinerate's 25% bonus applies to the whole hit is unverified; Bane of Havoc's point does nothing
Demon scaling uses Season of Discovery placeholder coefficients (Forever's are server-side): worth +49 on Demonology, +39 on the other builds
Succubus base melee is unverified: halved melee would cost Demonology 43, the other builds 38 to 39
Bane of Doom coefficient 4.0 (Era 1.0) is about 12% of Shadow Bolt builds' damage; at 2.0 they lose about 4%, at 1.0 about 6%
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI): 7 to 13 DPS below rank X/VIII/VII
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is live (the 5-piece added about +8 to +13 on the first set)
Soul shards and Life Tap health cost are not tracked
notes: Request straight from mksettings -spec destruction_fire -gear level60_phase1_synthetic -apl level60_destruction_fire -race Undead -duration 180, no edits. Demon Armor; Summon Succubus, sacrificed NoSummon, imbue Firestone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 5 / channelClipDelayMs 50 where the UI preset uses 25 / 150; the published numbers were made with mksettings and reproduce exactly. Bundled gear round (2026-10-13): request regenerated with mksettings on the merged class heads with the same arguments and edits as before; the gear set now carries the two synthetic trinkets, and the preset race moved from Gnome to Undead.
